claims.statement: Poland's environment ministry issued a March 2026 notice specifically because the 15 March 2026 deadline required correct BDO completion and transfer of product fees to regional authorities.
Polish law calculates the product-fee base from kilograms of each packaging type and provides for annual calculation and payment, making packaging mass a financially consequential data field.
EU Regulation 2025/40 places lifecycle and extended-producer-responsibility obligations on producers and requires reporting information that supports those obligations.

contrary_evidence: BDO already provides official reporting forms and instructions, so form completion alone is not a defensible product.
Many businesses transfer obligations to recovery organisations or advisers that may already maintain their calculations.
Small catalogues with stable packaging can be handled cheaply in a spreadsheet once per year.

economics.acquisition_route: Win one accounting or environmental adviser with 30-100 obligated clients, run a fixed-fee historical reconciliation, and share subscription revenue for converted accounts.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Eight hundred customers averaging 900 PLN monthly would produce 8.64m PLN annual recurring revenue. At a mature 42% owner-cash margin, about 3.63m PLN per year could support cumulative post-reinvestment distributions above 10m PLN over four mature years without a sale.
economics.founder_time: Start with one packaging category and no more than two adviser channels at about 3 hours/day, automating only after repeated paid reconciliations; stay employed through the stated traction and runway gates.
economics.gross_margin_basis: After BOM setup, reconciliation and workpaper generation are software-heavy; target 70-85% gross margin, with separately priced human classification review.
economics.payback: Target payback within one annual reporting cycle and under 5 months for channel-acquired accounts; proof requires measuring current adviser hours and fee corrections.
economics.pricing: Assumption to test: 1500-6000 PLN implementation, 350-1800 PLN monthly by SKU/transaction band, and 1500-5000 PLN for an independently reviewable annual filing pack.
economics.retention_or_repeat: New SKUs, supplier changes, monthly sales and annual obligations recur; a maintained BOM also becomes costly to replace, but very small catalogues may stay on spreadsheets.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A material- and packaging-type reference graph, supplier-document parser library and reconciliation-error corpus reduce setup cost across similar catalogues without pooling customer sales data.
fingerprint.customer: Polish e-commerce brands, private-label importers and distributors placing packaged goods on the Polish market, especially firms with hundreds or thousands of SKUs.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Accounting offices, environmental-compliance boutiques, packaging suppliers and fulfilment providers distribute a co-branded tool to their existing merchant base; onboarding is asynchronous from ERP exports.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: SaaS plus optional managed setup that maintains packaging BOMs, requests missing supplier evidence, infers suspect weights for review, reconciles transaction exports and produces documented BDO/producer-responsibility workpapers.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The operations or finance owner pays per company and SKU band at each reporting cycle; existing paid events include accountant or environmental-consultant time, recovery-organisation fees and product fees based on packaging mass.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A new SKU or supplier is introduced without reliable packaging weights, or the annual BDO/product-fee deadline requires sales and import data to be reconciled by packaging material.

founder_fit: The product is primarily data reconciliation, document extraction and rules engineering rather than relationship-heavy consulting.
Polish BDO complexity provides a local entry point while PPWR creates an EU expansion surface.
Accounting and fulfilment channels can support scalable distribution with limited public-persona demands.
A spreadsheet-in, workpaper-out pilot can be sold before a full platform is built.
risks: Automated weight inference could be mistaken for evidence and create an indefensible filing.
National EPR reform could change fee logic or consolidate the buyer set.
Advisers may resist a tool that reduces billable manual work.
SKU, supplier and sales data require contractual confidentiality and strict segregation.

structure.commercial_archetype: Compliance data ledger SaaS with annual filing service
structure.control_point: The canonical packaging BOM and placed-on-market mass calculation behind fees and filings
structure.critical_dependency: Customers must supply transaction exports and defensible packaging weights, while Polish implementation rules must remain machine-maintainable

thesis: Give Polish product importers and e-commerce brands a SKU-level packaging bill-of-materials ledger that reconciles purchases, imports and sales into BDO/EPR reporting and fee calculations. These firms already pay accountants, recovery organisations and product fees; the wedge is preventing repeated manual weighing, classification errors and unsupported annual totals as Polish rules coexist with the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation.
title: Packaging-Mass Reconciliation for BDO and EU EPR
uncertainties: The share of obligated merchants with sufficiently large, changing catalogues to justify monthly software is unknown.
No evidence yet shows how often packaging-mass errors lead to overpayment, arrears or audit findings in the target segment.
The practical availability of packaging weights from Asian and EU suppliers must be tested.
Pricing, channel conversion, margins and the wealth path are unsourced operating assumptions.
